location.name: Sagrada Família
location.why: Copied, photographed and imitated for over a century, and still being built. The builder keeps building.

youtube.title: 024 | FRAMES 👓 #philosophy #motivation
youtube.description:
If they're copying your blueprint, you're watching the wrong thing. Take your eyes off the copies and keep building.

They can copy the frames.

The color. The weight. The exact angle.

Watch them long enough and you forget what you were looking at.

The lenses were always clear.

—

linkedin.title: FRAMES · NDCH 024
linkedin.post:
They can copy the frames.

In any field, the visible parts of good work get copied first: the format, the branding, the pitch, the exact angle.

Watch the copies long enough and it's easy to forget what you were looking at in the first place. The clarity was never in the frame.

The lenses were always clear.
